A2.example: The valley is a rich agricultural region.

B1.definition: Lack of fairness or justice; an unjust act or situation occurring.
B1.example: Protesters gathered outside court to speak against social injustice in society.

B2.definition: a practice or policy designed to present an environmentally responsible image deceptively
B2.example: Environmental groups accused the oil corporation of greenwashing after its marketing campaign exaggerated renewable efforts.

C1.definition: causing disruption or annoyance through being unwelcome, prying, or uninvited
C1.example: Landlords are prohibited by law from making intrusive, unannounced visits to tenant rental property.

C2.definition: the set of medical symptoms characteristic of a particular medical condition or disease
C2.example: Clinicians documented the complex symptomatology observed in patients suffering from post-viral fatigue syndrome.
